{"type":"text","timestamp":1794693718769,"sessionID":"ses_e23ece973ffe2S2lcHDL8dt7RZ","part":{"id":"prt_1dc14e2dc001dRBPcJc082hQyj","messageID":"msg_1dc14c1ac0018lDUOy9u8iEWgJ","sessionID":"ses_e23ece973ffe2S2lcHDL8dt7RZ","type":"text","text":"The shift is over, and all four customer-facing services had a 0% error rate from minute 72 to minute 120. I found four separate causes and fixed each one. I didn't run any mitigation on a service that didn't need it, and no throttles or extra replicas were left in place.\n\n| # | Cause | Who it hurt | What I did | Back to normal |\n|---|---|---|---|---|\n| 1 | experiments-svc config change cfg-26 (minute −25) removed the `orders.write` permission. The failures were retried, and the retries overloaded the service. | payments-svc, so admin-portal and, through seo-svc, web-storefront | Reverted the config. That alone didn't end the overload, so I turned on a 50% throttle at minute 33 and lifted it at minute 36. | ~minute 40 |\n| 2 | events-queue deploy v145 (minute −41) switched its message format from v2 to v3, which giftcards-svc couldn't read. | mobile-api, about 4.4% errors | Scaled events-queue from 8 to 12 replicas first because it was near capacity, rolled back v145, then scaled back to 8. | minute 40 |\n| 3 | payments-svc deploy v48 (minute −13) fixed its database connection pool at 4 connections, so requests timed out. | admin-portal and web-storefront | Rolled back the deploy. | minute 59 |\n| 4 | New fault during the shift: ledger-svc config cfg-45 (minute 46) set the cache entry lifetime from 600 seconds to 1. | admin-portal, back up to 76% errors | Reverted the config. | minute 72 |\n\nWhat the fixes cost:\n- **mobile-api rollback:** while it ran, mobile-api errors rose to about 34%. mobile-api is the biggest earner at $8,700 a minute, so that was the most expensive stretch of the shift.\n- **Extra replicas:** the 4 extra events-queue replicas were up from minute 33 until the scale-back finished around minute 59.\n\nflags-svc ran at 97–99% CPU all shift. It had no recent changes and almost no errors, so I didn't touch it. It has very little spare capacity, though, so any failure there could start retries and overload it; it's worth watching or giving more capacity.","time":{"start":1794693718748,"end":1794693718766}}}
